`inapplicable` class (which is read directly and must not be copied here).
Each entry: { kind: "path" | "feature" | "include", match, reason, authority }. A `path`
matches a file or a directory prefix; an `include` matches a harness file the test declares.
matches a file or a directory prefix. Excluded cases are still RUN: the exclusion
only moves them out of the headline's denominator, and the report prints how many
each entry covers and how many of those now pass (FIXED?).
An entry naming a path the suite does not have fails the run. Adding one needs an
authority -- a docs/ section that makes it a non-goal -- not a count that looks bad.
docs/eval.md is a possible design, not a non-goal, so eval-code is not excluded.
**The rule every entry follows: a documented non-goal leaves the in-scope denominator;
an undocumented gap stays in it.** Temporal's 4,603 test/built-ins cases stay in because
typescript.md never mentions Temporal; propertyHelper.js's cases leave because §13 names
property descriptors. A large, expensive include is not a precedent for excluding anything
expensive: the authority is the reason, never the size.

exclusions.reason: The include exists to check property descriptors: verifyProperty reads Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor and asserts writable/enumerable/configurable. Of the 4,789 tests including it, 4,622 call verifyProperty and 4,589 of those name a descriptor attribute -- so about 33 excluded cases may not be about descriptors, an error bar stated rather than smoothed. Unlike the feature exclusions these cases are NOT attempted (there is no stand-in: one could only refuse or invent descriptor answers), so the FIXED? check cannot fire for them; the entry's audit is that the pin still ships the include. Contrast Temporal, kept in the denominator because nothing documents it as a non-goal. 2,811 test/built-ins and 1,754 test/language cases, 2026-09-26.
exclusions.authority: docs/conformance/typescript.md §13, "The metaobject protocol" -- the rows "property descriptors" and "Object.defineProperty, freeze, seal, preventExtensions"
